notes: Fixes #68: external Hermes cron watchdog detecting stalled/dead antigravity_core daemon, alerting via Telegram (hermes CLI, matching existing scripts/hermes/*.py pattern) with a computed suggested manual SL price (same Fibonacci Impulse Negation formula as inactivity_manager.py, reimplemented standalone since this script runs outside the mms4tk package). State persisted to host file per run. Alerts only when a position has floating profit >= MMS4TK_WATCHDOG_MIN_PROFIT_USD, once per stall episode. 13 new unit tests + full suite 467 passed (2 known pre-existing unrelated flaky tests excluded, same as PR #66/#73).
